name: The Shifting Weald
description: A vast, mutable forest where dream-logic warps geography and flora with each dawn fracture.
full_description: This treacherous wilderness borders Aethelgard's eastern marches, a place where trees might whisper secrets or rearrange themselves overnight, and paths refuse to stay fixed. The light filters through a perpetual, iridescent mist that carries psychic echoes of forgotten dreams. Travelers report seeing phantom cities in the distance and being stalked by semi-corporeal Nightmares shaped from collective fears. The only semi-reliable routes are the Vigil-patrolled 'Cinder Trails', paths lined with burnt salt and iron shavings. It is the primary barrier and source of danger between major Anchorholds.
